---
title: "String and date functions"
toc-depth: 3
---

Expression functions in `Phibble\Expr` for text, patterns, dates, datetimes, and periods, following stringr and lubridate.

## Strings

### `str_length()` {#str-length}

```php
str_length(mixed $x): Call
```

Number of characters in the string.

Characters are Unicode code points. NA gives NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `str_lower()` {#str-lower}

```php
str_lower(mixed $x): Call
```

String in lower case.

Alias of `str_to_lower()`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `str_to_title()` {#str-to-title}

```php
str_to_title(mixed $x): Call
```

String in title case.

The string is lowercased, then each letter that follows a character other than a letter, digit, or apostrophe is uppercased. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `str_trim()` {#str-trim}

```php
str_trim(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

String with leading and trailing white space removed.

All Unicode white space is removed, as in stringr. SQL backends evaluate it in memory.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: side (string, default 'both') is 'left', 'right', or 'both'. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `str_squish()` {#str-squish}

```php
str_squish(mixed $x): Call
```

String with white space trimmed from both ends and each inner run collapsed to one space.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `str_pad()` {#str-pad}

```php
str_pad(mixed $x, mixed $width, mixed ...$options): Call
```

String padded to at least `$width` characters.

Width counts Unicode code points; a string already at least that wide is unchanged. With side 'both', the extra padding goes on the right.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `$width` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The minimum width. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: side (string, default 'left') is 'left', 'right', or 'both'; pad (string, default ' ') is the padding, repeated once per missing character. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when side is not 'left', 'right', or 'both'.

### `str_trunc()` {#str-trunc}

```php
str_trunc(mixed $x, mixed $width, mixed ...$options): Call
```

String truncated to at most `$width` characters, ellipsis included.

Width counts Unicode code points; a string that fits is unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `$width` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The maximum width. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: side (string, default 'right') is the side to cut, 'right', 'left', or 'center'; ellipsis (string, default '...') marks the cut. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when side is not 'right', 'left', or 'center'.

### `str_sub()` {#str-sub}

```php
str_sub(mixed $x, mixed $start, mixed $end = -1): Call
```

Substring from position `$start` to position `$end`, inclusive.

Positions are 1-based characters; negative positions count from the end, so -1 is the last character. The result is NA where any argument is NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `$start` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The first position. |
| `$end` | <code>mixed</code> | <code>-1</code> | The last position; the default, -1, is the end of the string. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

```php
paste(mixed ...$args): Call
```

### `paste0()` {#paste0}

```php
paste0(mixed ...$args): Call
```

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

## Patterns

### `fixed()` {#fixed}

```php
fixed(mixed $pattern): Call
```

Pattern that matches its text literally.

An empty `fixed()` pattern gives NA in the functions that take it.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$pattern` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The literal text to match. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `regex()` {#regex}

```php
regex(mixed $pattern, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Regular-expression pattern with options.

Patterns are PCRE and match by Unicode code point.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$pattern` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The regular expression, without delimiters. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: ignore_case (bool, default false) matches without regard to case. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `str_detect()` {#str-detect}

```php
str_detect(mixed $x, mixed $pattern, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Whether the string contains a match for the pattern.

A plain string pattern is a regular expression; wrap it in `fixed()` to match literal text. NA gives NA, as does an empty `fixed()` pattern.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `$pattern` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A regular expression, `fixed()`, or `regex()`. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: negate (bool, default false) inverts the result. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `str_starts()` {#str-starts}

```php
str_starts(mixed $x, mixed $pattern, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Whether the string starts with a match for the pattern.

A plain string pattern is a regular expression; wrap it in `fixed()` to match literal text. NA gives NA, as does an empty `fixed()` pattern.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `$pattern` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A regular expression, `fixed()`, or `regex()`. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: negate (bool, default false) inverts the result. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

```php
str_ends(mixed $x, mixed $pattern, mixed ...$options): Call
```

A plain string pattern is a regular expression; wrap it in `fixed()` to match literal text. NA gives NA, as does an empty `fixed()` pattern.


### `str_replace()` {#str-replace}

```php
str_replace(mixed $x, mixed $pattern, mixed $replacement): Call
```

String with the first match of the pattern replaced.

In a regular-expression replacement, \1 to \9 refer to capture groups, and $ is literal. An NA replacement gives NA where the pattern matches.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `$pattern` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A regular expression, `fixed()`, or `regex()`. |
| `$replacement` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The replacement string. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `str_replace_all()` {#str-replace-all}

```php
str_replace_all(mixed $x, mixed $pattern, mixed $replacement): Call
```

String with every match of the pattern replaced.

In a regular-expression replacement, \1 to \9 refer to capture groups, and $ is literal. An NA replacement gives NA where the pattern matches.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `$pattern` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A regular expression, `fixed()`, or `regex()`. |

**Returns** `Call`

### `str_split()` {#str-split}

```php
str_split(mixed $x, mixed $pattern): Call
```

Pieces of the string split at each match of the pattern, as a list.

An empty `fixed()` pattern splits into characters. NA gives a list holding one NA. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `$pattern` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A regular expression, `fixed()`, or `regex()`. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `str_split_i()` {#str-split-i}

```php
str_split_i(mixed $x, mixed $pattern, mixed $i): Call
```

Piece `$i` of the string split at each match of the pattern.

The result is NA when `$i` is 0 or out of range. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `$pattern` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A regular expression, `fixed()`, or `regex()`. |
| `$i` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The 1-based piece number; a negative number counts from the end. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

## Parsing dates

### `ymd()` {#ymd}

```php
ymd(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Date parsed from text with year, month, and day in that order.

Digits may run together (20240131) or be separated by any non-digits. Invalid input gives NA. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: tz (string, default none) parses to a datetime at midnight in that time zone; without it, the result is a date. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when tz is not a known time zone.

### `dmy()` {#dmy}

```php
dmy(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Date parsed from text with day, month, and year in that order.

Digits may run together (31012024) or be separated by any non-digits. Invalid input gives NA. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: tz (string, default none) parses to a datetime at midnight in that time zone; without it, the result is a date. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when tz is not a known time zone.

### `mdy()` {#mdy}

```php
mdy(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Date parsed from text with month, day, and year in that order.

Digits may run together (01312024) or be separated by any non-digits. Invalid input gives NA. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: tz (string, default none) parses to a datetime at midnight in that time zone; without it, the result is a date. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when tz is not a known time zone.

### `ymd_hms()` {#ymd-hms}

```php
ymd_hms(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Datetime parsed from text with year, month, day, hour, minute, and second in that order.

Seconds may have a fraction. Invalid input, and a local time the zone skips, give NA. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: tz (string, default 'UTC') is the time zone of the clock time. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when tz is not a known time zone.

### `dmy_hms()` {#dmy-hms}

```php
dmy_hms(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Datetime parsed from text with day, month, year, hour, minute, and second in that order.

Seconds may have a fraction. Invalid input, and a local time the zone skips, give NA. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: tz (string, default 'UTC') is the time zone of the clock time. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when tz is not a known time zone.

### `mdy_hms()` {#mdy-hms}

```php
mdy_hms(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Datetime parsed from text with month, day, year, hour, minute, and second in that order.

Seconds may have a fraction. Invalid input, and a local time the zone skips, give NA. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: tz (string, default 'UTC') is the time zone of the clock time. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when tz is not a known time zone.

### `parse_date_time()` {#parse-date-time}

```php
parse_date_time(mixed $x, mixed $orders, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Datetime parsed from text by the first of the given orders that fits.

Order letters are Y (four-digit year), y (two-digit year: 00 to 68 are 2000s, 69 to 99 1900s), m, d, H, M, and S; spaces and the separators - / : _ in an order are ignored. A missing month or day is 1, and a missing hour, minute, or second is 0; an order without a year matches nothing. Text no order fits gives NA. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A string expression or literal. |
| `$orders` | <code>mixed</code> |  | One order, such as 'Ymd HMS', or a list of orders. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: tz (string, default 'UTC') is the time zone of the clock time. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when an order has another letter, or tz is not a known time zone.

## Rounding and differences

### `floor_date()` {#floor-date}

```php
floor_date(mixed $x, mixed $unit, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Date or datetime rounded down to the start of its unit.

SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A date or datetime expression. |
| `$unit` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The unit, optionally with a count, such as 'month' or '15 minutes': second, minute, hour, day, week, month, bimonth, quarter, or year. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: week_start (int, default 7) is the first day of a week, from 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when the unit is unknown.

### `ceiling_date()` {#ceiling-date}

```php
ceiling_date(mixed $x, mixed $unit, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Date or datetime rounded up to the start of the next unit.

A datetime already on a boundary is unchanged; a date moves to the next boundary, as in lubridate. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A date or datetime expression. |
| `$unit` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The unit, optionally with a count, such as 'month' or '15 minutes': second, minute, hour, day, week, month, bimonth, quarter, or year. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: week_start (int, default 7) is the first day of a week, from 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when the unit is unknown.

### `round_date()` {#round-date}

```php
round_date(mixed $x, mixed $unit, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Date or datetime rounded to the nearer of `floor_date()` and `ceiling_date()`.

A value halfway between rounds up. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A date or datetime expression. |
| `$unit` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The unit, optionally with a count, such as 'month' or '15 minutes': second, minute, hour, day, week, month, bimonth, quarter, or year. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: week_start (int, default 7) is the first day of a week, from 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when the unit is unknown.

### `difftime()` {#difftime}

```php
difftime(mixed $x, mixed $y, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Difference `$x` - `$y` between two dates or datetimes, as a float in the given units.

The result is NA where either value is NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A date or datetime expression. |
| `$y` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A date or datetime expression. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: units (string, default 'days') is 'secs', 'mins', 'hours', 'days', or 'weeks'. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when units is another value.

## Time zones and the clock

### `with_tz()` {#with-tz}

```php
with_tz(mixed $x, mixed $tz): Call
```

Same instant shown in another time zone.

SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A datetime expression. |
| `$tz` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The time zone name, such as 'America/New_York'. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when the time zone is unknown.

### `force_tz()` {#force-tz}

```php
force_tz(mixed $x, mixed $tz): Call
```

Same clock time in another time zone, which changes the instant.

A clock time the zone skips, in a daylight saving gap, gives NA. SQL backends evaluate it in memory when it reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A datetime expression. |
| `$tz` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The time zone name, such as 'America/New_York'. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when the time zone is unknown.

### `today()` {#today}

```php
today(mixed ...$options): Call
```

Current date.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: tz (string, default 'UTC') is the time zone whose calendar gives the date. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when tz is not a known time zone.

### `now()` {#now}

```php
now(mixed ...$options): Call
```

Current date and time.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: tz (string, default 'UTC') is the time zone of the result. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when tz is not a known time zone.

### `Clock::freeze()` {#clock-freeze}

```php
Clock::freeze(?DateTimeImmutable $at): void
```

Fix the time that `today()` and `now()` read. Null restores the system clock.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$at` | <code>?DateTimeImmutable</code> |  |  |

**Static method** of `Phibble\Expr\Clock`

### `Clock::now()` {#clock-now}

```php
Clock::now(): DateTimeImmutable
```

The current time in UTC, or the frozen time.

**Static method** of `Phibble\Expr\Clock`\
**Returns** `DateTimeImmutable`
